name: Google Vision OCR
label: Cloud Vision API v1 — OCR
description: Cloud Vision API v1 — OCR. Official API https://cloud.google.com/vision/docs/ocr. One node; pick operation. Upload/download/convert/sign payloads use type file (Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.) Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Images leave the daemon to Google. DPA/BAA if PHI. StudioQuack stored type is file; Vision's JSON content field is wire encoding only. Multi-page PDF/TIFF uses files:asyncBatchAnnotate + GCS — not a silent scrape.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields (operation, requests). Do not put secrets on this port. Images go in requests[].image (gs:// or Vision content).

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: text_detection, document_text_detection, label_detection.

schema.label: requests
schema.description: One AnnotateImageRequest object escape hatch merged into requests[0]. Named content/imageUri/type win. Example: {"image":{"content":"<base64>"},"features":[{"type":"TEXT_DETECTION"}]}.

schema.label: content
schema.description: images:annotate image.content (base64). Wired to requests[0].image.content. Prefer a platform file elsewhere; this is Vision's wire encoding.

schema.label: imageUri
schema.description: images:annotate image.source.imageUri (gs:// or https). Wired to requests[0].image.source.imageUri. Example: gs://bucket/img.jpg.

schema.label: type
schema.description: images:annotate features[0].type. EXACT: TEXT_DETECTION | DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION | LABEL_DETECTION. Match the operation. Example: TEXT_DETECTION.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (cloud-platform scope). StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.
